title: Why Ryan Keeps Getting Ghosted (The Algorithm Knows)
description: Ryan swipes right on everyone and can't work out why nobody matches. Maya explains how dating apps really decide who you see — Tinder's old chess-style Elo score, Hinge's Nobel-prize 'stable matching' maths, and why too many choices make people choose nothing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hinge says it uses something else: the Gale-Shapley algorithm, a piece of maths from 1962 for making stable matches. The work behind it won a Nobel prize in economics in 2012.
